summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Admin 'Send Reports' feature (admin -> publishers). All 15 pytest backend tests passed and all UI flows worked end-to-end. Report send (selected/all), listing, expiry auto-purge, delete, download (bytes match, content-disposition attachment with original filename), downloaded flag persistence, notifications, admin download_count increment, throwaway (audience 'selected' isolation) all verified. Cleaned up throwaway user, test reports, login_attempts.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1730 — user_ids is only parsed when audience=='selected'. Reasonable, but the 400 for empty selected is raised AFTER file already uploaded to storage (put_object) and a files row inserted. Result: a small orphan blob + files row (is_deleted=false) is created for every failed selected-with-no-ids attempt. Consider validating audience/user_ids BEFORE writing to storage.
server.py:1717 title='' after strip returns 400, but FastAPI Form(...) required means missing title yields 422 (validated in test).
server.py:1790 Content-Disposition uses non-RFC5987 encoding — for filenames with unicode it may not decode nicely. sanitize via re.sub keeps ASCII so acceptable for now.
AdminReports.jsx uses q (search state) inside the customers filter — search state is not reset between opens; minor UX only.
Reports.jsx download: on 404 (expired) toast text says 'File not available (it may have expired)' — good.
